messages:
Priya Desai: ACME reached out: they want to renew early with a volume move. Request: 50 seats moved from team 'dev-team' to 'ops-team', and a 12% early-sign discount if signed by 2024-12-05. Also asking for a prorated credit for unused seats through 2025-07-01. Need billing + legal input.
Marco Liu: 12% might be doable with finance approval. Need current seat price and the exact effective date. Also ask if they want term to remain 12 months or extend.
Priya Desai: Current price per seat = $40/mo (billed monthly on annual contract). ARR is $96k. They want to keep annual term but start the moved seats effective 2024-12-01.
Eva Gomez: Legal: we'll need an amendment and a signed SOW with new seat allocations. For prorate language use standard "Time-based prorate" clause: credit = seat_price * remaining_days / 365. Add a line that credits will be applied as invoice adjustment on next billing cycle.
Theo Barnes: Billing: can calculate provisional credit but final amount requires PO showing both old and new billing entities. If they want the credit applied as refund instead of invoice credit, we need finance ops to approve.
Priya Desai: Customer prefers credit on next invoice, not refund. They will provide PO tonight. Marco / Theo, can you prepare provisional adjustment schedule?
Marco Liu: Will do. I'll attach a draft invoice and provisional credit table. Expect ETA 2 hours.
billing-bot: Provisional adjustment created: ADJ-20241201-ACME (link: https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-20241201-ACME)
Eva Gomez: Addendum draft uploaded to Drive: https://drive.internal/ACME/early_renewal_addendum_v3.docx. I included clause: "No further price reductions or concessions will be made post-execution."
Priya Desai: Great. I'll confirm names for the 50 users and share SSO mapping CSV. Sophie from onboarding is looped in separately.
Theo Barnes: FYI finance: if PO references invoice INV-6021 we can auto-apply credit. Otherwise manual reconciliation required.
Marco Liu: Noted. If they sign by 2024-12-05 we can honor 12% and lock price for 12 months. After that standard pricing applies.
Priya Desai: I'll send DocuSign to renewals@acme.com and cc accounts-payable@acme.com and legal@redwood.com. Targeting signature by 2024-12-03. :rocket:
